_comment: Prompts in the vocabulary of AnimationGPT's CombatMotion dataset (weapon type, action type, attack type, power, speed, root motion). One clip per entry: the name is the file the game plays (assets/motion/<name>.json).

clips.name: katana_light_1
clips.prompt: weapon attack a man holding a Katana,executing a Light Attack,Two-Handed,root motion get Forward, Swift,Light-Weighted and Relative Fast,Slash,Cleanly, the character steps forward with the right foot and swings the sword horizontally from the right side to the left side

clips.name: katana_light_2
clips.prompt: weapon attack a man holding a Katana,executing a Light Attack,Two-Handed,root motion get Forward, Swift,Light-Weighted and Relative Fast,Slash,Cleanly, the character raises the sword above the left shoulder then cuts diagonally downward to the right

clips.name: katana_light_3
clips.prompt: weapon attack a man holding a Katana,executing a Light Attack,Right-Handed,In-Place, Swift,Steady,Slash,Cleanly, the character crouches, turns around in a full circle and swings the sword in a wide horizontal arc

clips.name: katana_heavy
clips.prompt: weapon attack a man holding a Katana,executing a Charged Heavy Attack,Two-Handed,root motion get Forward, Steady,Powerful and Relative Slow,First slow then fast,Cleanly, the character lifts the sword above the head and slams it down with a deep lunge

clips.name: katana_counter
clips.prompt: weapon attack a man holding a Katana,executing a Light Attack,Two-Handed,root motion get Forward, Swift,Relative Fast,Slash,Cleanly, the character answers with a fast rising slash from the lower right to the upper left

clips.name: katana_assassinate
clips.prompt: weapon attack a man holding a Katana,executing a Piercing Attack,Two-Handed,root motion get Forward, Steady,Powerful,Cleanly, the character thrusts the sword straight forward with a long step and holds the pose

clips.name: katana_iai
clips.prompt: weapon attack a man holding a Katana,executing a Light Attack,Right-Handed,root motion get Forward, Swift,Relative Fast,Slash,Cleanly, the character crouches with the hand on the hilt, then draws the sword in one horizontal flash to the right

clips.name: hit_f
clips.prompt: get hit, the character is struck from the front and is pushed backward, the upper body leans back and the arms swing out, then recovers

clips.name: hit_b
clips.prompt: get hit, the character is struck from behind and stumbles forward, the upper body arches, then recovers

clips.name: stagger
clips.prompt: get hit, the character loses balance and staggers backward several steps with the arms out, then hunches over, dazed

clips.name: roll
clips.prompt: a person does a quick forward dodge roll and stands up
